name: prof-openloop
description: ISR profiling in OpenLoop drive: 0.3 A rotating vector at 75 rad/s el for ~6.5 s of steady seconds + 1 kHz stream. Exercises the full per-cycle path (cmd/prot/ctrl/est incl. observer) without the sensorless startup sequencer — clean A/B seconds for shave work even while the sensorless handoff is blocked by the distortion floor.
